cv.name: Daniel Karamanlis
cv.headline: HR Business Partner | Retail & Hospitality | Former Store Manager
cv.summary: HR business partner with six years in people and culture, following eight years in retail store management. Brings operational credibility with frontline leaders and solid knowledge of the Fair Work Act and modern awards.

experience.title: HR Business Partner
bullets: Partner with the NSW operations leadership team covering 2,100 employees in 38 stores
Advise managers on performance management, investigations and terminations under the Fair Work Act
Support enterprise agreement negotiations and award compliance reviews
Reduced first-year turnover of store managers from 34% to 21%

experience.title: People & Culture Advisor
bullets: Handled employee relations cases and onboarding across 12 venues
Ran payroll checks against the Hospitality Industry (General) Award

experience.title: Store Manager
bullets: Managed a store team of 55 and A$12M in annual sales

education.degree: Graduate Diploma in Human Resource Management

skills: Fair Work Act, modern awards, enterprise agreements
